adjudication.rationale: `Jobs::PollFeed` defines `feed_key` (poll_feed.rb:20-22) but never uses it; there is no conditional check (e.g., Redis/Last-Modified/ETag) to avoid re-fetching. In `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve`, when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true it calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})`, which in turn calls `poll_feed` and unconditionally does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates all items. This can cause repeated full-feed downloads on embed retrieval paths, but it’s primarily an efficiency/incomplete-wiring issue rather than a correctness defect proven by the diff.
